title: 第一卷 第17章 分赃五五开第一卷 第18章 把人当狗遛
content_zh:
只半日的时间，顾尘便初步见到了修行界的残酷，自然明白，这些人整日里打打杀杀，疗伤的东西肯定是不缺的。
只是——
这些丹瓶虽也有十来只，可长得都大差不差，他这个门外汉根本无法判断哪种丹药是用来疗伤的，只能干瞪眼，不敢吃。
“吼！！”
正犹豫着是不是赌一把，试一试的时候，一声低吼再次响起，吓了他一跳。
一抬头。
发现九骨蜥两只冒绿光的眼睛正紧紧盯着那些丹瓶，眼中的仇恨少了很多，取而代之的是一丝渴望之意。
顾尘心里一动。
试着拿起一只丹瓶：“想吃？”
“吼！”
九骨蜥下意识点头，眼神更渴望了，竟是一时间忘了先前被顾尘恶毒对待的事了。
顾尘满面狐疑。
犹豫了一会，他打开一只丹瓶，随手扔了一颗黄澄澄的丹丸过去。
话可以乱说。
东西不可以乱吃。
这是九骨蜥刚刚经历的惨痛教训换来的经验，所以……这次它嘴巴闭得很牢。
直至丹药落地。
它才小心翼翼嗅了嗅，眼神微微一亮，舌头一卷，吞了进去，而后又是看了一眼顾尘那条断掉的胳膊。
治伤的？
顾尘心里一动，却没直接服药，又是小心观察了一会九骨蜥的状态，发现服药之后，对方精神好了很多，断牙的地方也不再流血，这才放心，再不管其他，一股脑将那丹瓶的丹丸全倒进了嘴里。

“吼！”
九骨蜥有点着急。
更给我留点！
顾尘也没功夫理它，丹药入腹，顿时化开，一缕缕清凉而又温和的气息在他的四肢百骸之中不断游走，他那条断掉的手臂竟是不断愈合了起来，先前和孟海一战留下的暗伤，亦是不断恢复了起来！
他的眼睛又亮了！
再次看向九骨蜥，眼中的防备亦是少了一点。
“蜥兄。”
想了想，他试探道：“我有个提议要不要听一听……”
连比划带说。
他将自己的意图表达了出来。
简而言之。
你告诉我丹药的用法，我分给你好处，共同携手，实现双赢！
“吼吼吼！”
九骨蜥连番低吼，想都没想就同意了！
它只是妖兽，还是一只没化形的低阶妖兽，在今日之前，又哪里真正尝过人族灵丹妙药的滋味？
更因为顾尘的野路子行为，它早已经吃顺口了，也不想要断牙，更想要双赢！
当即！
一人一蜥的意见弯成了高度统一！
content_en:
In just half a day, Gu Chen had an initial glimpse of the cruelty of the cultivation world, and naturally understood that these people were fighting and killing all day long, and there must be no shortage of healing things.
Just——
Although there were about a dozen of these elixir bottles, they all looked pretty much the same. As a layman, he couldn't tell which elixir was used to heal wounds, so he could only stare at them and not dare to eat them.
"Roar!!"
Just as he was hesitating whether to take a gamble and give it a try, a low growl sounded again, startling him.
Look up.
He found that the nine-bone lizard's two glowing green eyes were staring closely at the pill bottles. The hatred in his eyes was much less, replaced by a trace of desire.
Gu Chen's heart moved.
Trying to pick up an elixir bottle: "Want to eat?"
"Roar!"
The Nine-Bone Lizard nodded subconsciously, its eyes even more eager, and for a moment she forgot about the previous vicious treatment by Gu Chen.
Gu Chen's face was filled with suspicion.
After hesitating for a while, he opened a pill bottle and threw a yellow pill over.
You can say random things.
Don't eat random things.
This is the experience gained from the painful lesson that the Nine Bone Lizard has just experienced, so... this time it kept its mouth tightly closed.
Until the elixir falls to the ground.
It sniffed carefully, its eyes brightened slightly, rolled its tongue, and swallowed, and then glanced at Gu Chen's broken arm.
To heal injuries?
Gu Chen's heart moved, but he didn't take the medicine directly. He carefully observed the condition of the Nine Bone Lizard for a while, and found that after taking the medicine, the other party's energy improved a lot, and the place where the broken tooth stopped bleeding. Then he felt relieved, and without caring about anything else, he poured all the pills from the pill bottle into his mouth.
"Roar!"
The Nine Bone Lizard was a little anxious.
Leave some more for me!
Gu Chen didn't have time to pay attention to it. The elixir entered his stomach and immediately melted away. Wisps of cool and gentle breath continued to circulate among his limbs. His broken arm actually continued to heal, and the hidden wounds left in the previous battle with Meng Hai also continued to recover!
His eyes lit up again!
Looking at the Nine Bone Lizard again, the defensiveness in his eyes was also a little less.
"Brother Lizard."
After thinking for a while, he tentatively said: "I have a suggestion. Do you want to listen to it..."
Talking and gesticulating.
He made his intentions clear.
in short.
You tell me how to use the elixir, and I will share the benefits with you. Let’s work together to achieve a win-win situation!
"Ho ho ho!"
The Nine Bone Lizard roared repeatedly and agreed without even thinking!
It is just a monster, or a low-level monster that has not transformed. Before today, how could it have truly tasted the human race's elixir?
Moreover, because of Gu Chen's wild behavior, it has already been able to eat well. It doesn't want to lose its teeth, but wants a win-win situation!
Immediately!
The opinions of one person and one lizard have become highly unified!
